title: The Stars' Small Camping Trip
synopsis: Three make-believe stars camp between clouds with a tiny spoon, pretend moonberry soup, and an unhurried goodnight.

related_resources.reason: Age-relevant guidance recommends shared story time and following children’s comments; not a measurement of sleep.
Imagination and prediction are discussed as ways adults can engage with a story; the fictional stars are not astronomical teaching material.

rationale_citations.story_anchor: They packed a tiny tent made of dark blue night.
rationale_citations.editorial_rationale: A clear fantasy premise sets the playful sky-world, not a literal astronomical claim.
rationale_citations.evidence_scope: Parent/caregiver guidance supports only broad age-appropriate editorial practices. It does not assess this original story or prove any cognitive, behavioral or sleep outcome.

rationale_citations.editorial_rationale: A simple repeated goodnight marks a naturally settling narrative closure.
